items.title: Geno Smith: Opening Week 11 with limited practice
items.description:
Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Smith (ankle) will be a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

items.title: Baker Mayfield: Looking unlikely for Week 11
items.description:
The Buccaneers aren't ruling Mayfield (foot) out from playing in Sunday's game at Detroit, but the team views the quarterback as "probably a long shot for this week," Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Could be back around Week 16
items.description:
The Ravens believe "there's a chance" that Jackson (thumb) could return for their Week 16 matchup with the Browns, assuming all goes well in his recovery from right thumb surgery, Dan Graziano of ESPN.com reports.
